description: This file is a Java test class named ImmutableJsonObjectTest, containing unit tests for the ImmutableJsonObject class in the package org.eclipse.ditto.json. The tests verify deserialization, immutability, equality, hashCode, setting and removing values, handling of JSON pointers, field selectors, and internal caching strategies.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectTest
classes.description: A comprehensive Java JUnit test class for the ImmutableJsonObject class in package org.eclipse.ditto.json. It verifies various functionalities such as equality, immutability, setting/removing values, handling JSON pointers and selectors, serialization, and internal caching.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableJsonObject and its internal classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode are properly implemented, including behavior with different object instances.

methods.name: orderOfFieldsDoesNotAffectEquality
methods.description: Checks that different ordering of fields does not affect equality of JSON objects.

methods.name: twoParsedObjectsFromSameStringHaveSameHashCode
methods.description: Ensures that two JSON strings parsed into objects produce equal objects with same hashcodes.

methods.name: getEmptyInstanceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that an empty ImmutableJsonObject returns expected properties and toString output.

methods.name: objectIsNothingElse
methods.description: Validates that the empty object does not support any other types and behaves as a null-like object.

methods.name: checkUnsupportedOperations
methods.description: Ensures that the object does not support unsupported data retrieval methods.

methods.name: getInstanceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks proper retrieval of values and serialization from an example object.

methods.name: getReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct retrieval of a specific key-value pair.

methods.name: setWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that setting a value results in a new disjoint JsonObject with the updated value.

methods.name: tryToSetIntValueWithNullKey
methods.description: Ensures that setting a null key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetIntValueWithEmptyKey
methods.description: Ensures that setting an empty key throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setIntCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies setting an int value creates a new object without affecting the original.

methods.name: setExistingIntReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks that setting a value with the same key and value returns the same JsonObject instance.

methods.name: setIntWithKeyContainingSlashes
methods.description: Tests keys with slashes are handled correctly.

methods.name: setFieldTwiceReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Verifies updating a field with the same value returns the same object.

methods.name: setLongCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Checks setting a long value creates a new object.

methods.name: setDoubleCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Checks setting a double value creates a new object.

methods.name: setBooleanCreatesDisjointJsonObject
methods.description: Checks setting a boolean value creates a new object.

methods.name: setStringCreatesDisjoint
methods.description: Checks setting a string value creates a new object.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures setting a null JsonPointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithEmptyJsonPointer
methods.description: Ensures setting with an empty pointer throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToSetValueWithSlashCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures setting with key '/' throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setValueWithSlashJsonKeyWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Ensures keys with slash characters are handled correctly.

methods.name: setValueWithJsonPointerToEmptyJsonObject

methods.name: setValueWithJsonPointerToExistingJsonObject

methods.name: tryToAddAllWithNullJsonFieldsIterable

methods.name: setAllWithEmptyJsonFieldIterableReturnsSameJsonObject
methods.description: Verifies that setting an empty collection returns the same object.

methods.name: setAllJsonFieldsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding multiple fields via setAll.

methods.name: tryToGetValueByNullName

methods.name: getValueWithEmptyStringReturnsEmptyOptional

methods.name: tryToGetValueByNullKey
methods.description: Ensures getValue with null JsonKey throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getExistingValueByName

methods.name: getNonExistingValueByNameReturnsEmptyOptional

methods.name: getExistingValueByKeyReturnsExpected
